name: Sphère d’éjection atmosphérique
lore: Le siège d’éjection suit le concept WIP 11 de Mat Hunkin (22/04/24). Le nom « sphère atmosphérique », son enveloppe fermée et ses capacités de jeu ne sont pas établis par cette planche.

assets.label: Éjection — siège WIP 11 indépendant
assets.prompt: Create a faithful painted 2D game bitmap module based ONLY on the LEFT-HALF EJECTOR SEAT WIP 11 UPDATED CONTROLLER 22/04/24 of this Mat Hunkin Predator Badlands concept sheet. Preserve its dark charcoal reclining segmented padded seat, five chunky backrest cushions, angular lower basin with curved rim and silver-blue striated metal, short side armrests, round low pivots and gently bowed articulated overhead controller arch with the compact pale bronze/grey paired-lobe red-lined head. The arch attaches mechanically beside the seat and bends over its front, matching the reference. NO rider. NO right-hand round navigation-console module from the sheet. No added globe, canopy, wings, wheels, weapons, floating extra parts or imagined exterior shell. Exactly TWO complete orthographic SIDE elevation seat modules side by side: first front pointing RIGHT, second front pointing LEFT, same dimensions and seated scale. All parts fit within each half with at least 10 percent blank margins, no overlap. Use a clean flat pure magenta #FF00FF background for game extraction, no shadows or ground. Detailed worn machined dark metal and fabric, coherent perspective and attachments. No labels, text, signatures, logos or original concept-sheet framing. This is an interior module adaptation, not the whole escape vehicle.

references.role: Primary artist portfolio; Ejector Seat WIP 11 22/04/24 inspected

notes: Module intérieur de siège uniquement ; ce visuel ne valide ni une coque sphérique ni une animation complète.
Adaptation latérale d’un concept de production, pas certification de la version finale du film.

assets.label: Éjection — bras de commande articulé
assets.prompt: Create ONE game animation sheet for the INDEPENDENT ARTICULATED OVERHEAD CONTROLLER ARCH from the LEFT HALF of the supplied Mat Hunkin EJECTOR SEAT WIP 11 22/04/24 concept. Do not use the right-hand navigation console. Isolate only the bronze-grey ribbed mechanical C-shaped arch, its round basal pivot, silver linkage ribs, and its pale two-lobed control head with fine red glowing line inlays. No chair, cushion, rider, hands, torso, capsule or other module. Exactly FOUR chronological poses in ONE horizontal row, every pose facing RIGHT: folded/stowed behind base, partly extending overhead, nearly extended, final arch bent forward with control head above hypothetical lap. Fixed basal pivot position relative to each equal cell, same scale, same segment count and same control head shape at every frame. Each arm is a continuous connected mechanism, no floating segments. Pure magenta #FF00FF background, no shadows. Orthographic side view for a 2D game, detailed painted metal matching reference. Wide empty gutters and 12 percent padding within each equal cell. No text, numbers, gridlines, logos or watermark. Show plausible joint rotation without stretching components.

references.role: Primary artist portfolio; Ejector Seat WIP 11 22/04/24 inspected

notes: Module intérieur de siège uniquement ; ce visuel ne valide ni une coque sphérique ni une animation complète.
Adaptation latérale d’un concept de production, pas certification de la version finale du film.

assets.label: Éjection — siège sans bras mobile
assets.prompt: Edit this game module sheet precisely. Preserve the exact two side-by-side seat bodies, five-cushion dark upholstery, angular low basin, armrests, round low pivots, worn dark bronze/silver-blue structure, equal scale, same facing directions and same positions. REMOVE the entire tall overhead articulated arch and its large pale-red control head from BOTH views so the chair can be combined with a separately animated arm. End the chair rear cleanly at its top cushion and a small capped side mounting socket; no tall support, no leftover cable crossing the empty space above it. This is a detachable mechanical part removal, no other redesign. Keep BOTH complete empty seats on uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background. No rider, legs, hands, cockpit globe, ground shadow or added objects. Leave generous margins. No text, watermark or logo.
